visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-definition close-up of a holographic 3D basketball court is displayed on a physical wooden desk. A male hand with a black watch enters from the right, pointing at the court. Yellow bold text '用Vision Pro看NBA' is overlaid at the top. The lighting is bright and indoor, casting soft shadows on the desk surface. (2) The screen transitions to a digital interface overlay showing 'LEAGUE PASS PREMIUM' pricing details and subscription buttons. A small circular video inset appears at the bottom, featuring a man with glasses wearing a white Apple Vision Pro headset. He gestures with his hands while looking at the virtual interface. (3) Back to the 3D court, miniature player avatars are seen running and dribbling. The background is a dimly lit studio with shelves. The camera moves dynamically around the court to show the spatial depth. Small text overlays indicate player names like 'D. GARLAND' floating above the avatars. (4) The scene changes to a bright office environment. The 3D court is now positioned on a white desk. A person's hand reaches into the frame to point out the details of the player jerseys and the 'Moda Center' logo on the virtual floor. The lighting is natural daylight from large windows. (5) A man wearing a white t-shirt and blue jeans sits on a beige sofa, wearing the Vision Pro headset. He tilts his head as if following the action. The final shot shows a person from behind in a black jacket, wearing the headset at an office workstation with several monitors showing editing software.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 用Vision Pro看NBA. [Subtitle]: 各位如果你愛看NBA. (2) [Subtitle]: 你一定要試試看Vision Pro. (3) [Subtitle]: 它的一個新功能叫做TableTop. (4) [Logo]: NBA. [Subtitle]: 顧名思義就是你只要開通它的會員之後. (5) [Subtitle]: 你就可以直接看到球場上兩隊的人在那跑來跑去的畫面. (6) [Subtitle]: 例如在這邊擋拆、助攻等等的. (7) [Subtitle]: 彷彿我是一個總教練的概念. (8) [Subtitle]: 也可以邊走有沒有, 它就變成一個很像桌上遊戲的感覺. (9) [Subtitle]: 很像別人在你面前打2K給你看, 超有臨場感的. (10) [Subtitle]: 而且它那個球場的動畫, 整個出來的畫面超帥. (11) [Subtitle]: 連剛剛犯規被撞倒在地上的那個畫面都有. (12) [Subtitle]: 球號是正確的嗎? 球員上的名字都有. (13) [Subtitle]: 球衣是正確的, 因為我們有時候在看比賽, 它轉播畫面會一直切切切. (14) [Subtitle]: 可是例如我特別喜歡一個球員的話, 我可以全場一直關注說那個球員的走位怎樣. (15) [Subtitle]: 你可以知道他這場有沒有在摸魚, 他狀態好不好. (16) [Subtitle]: 但不是每一場都有, 它這個功能還在Alpha. (17) [Subtitle]: 所以應該要那個球場的攝影機要有支援這個功能. (18) [Subtitle]: 期待它未來連長相都會像2K一樣是球員的長相. (19) [Subtitle]: 好啦那接下來白天上班我會監視你有沒有帶著這個Vision Pro.

No ambient noise or environmental interference is audible. The acoustic environment sounds like a treated studio. (5) The audio concludes with a more casual, humorous vocal delivery during the office segment. The music swells slightly towards the end before a final hard cut to silence. The overall mix is clean and well-balanced.
